title: bardolier config file (~/.config/bardolier/config.yml)
description: cli-spec.md §8. Lives on the INTERNAL disk so doctor/status can report a root as unreadable rather than failing. Every key is optional; a missing file is equivalent to an empty one.

roots.description: Ordered; roots[0] is the default `new` targets. Names and paths must each be unique. Overridden wholesale by $BARDOLIER_ROOT, which replaces this list with a single root named after the path's basename (phase 18). Not editable through `config set` — see `bardolier root add | remove | list`.

catalogue_path.description: Service catalogue location (§4.1). Unset falls back to <default root>/services.yml, then the bundled default.

terminal.description: Terminal the APP uses for shell-open (app-spec.md §7, §12). Surfaced here so there is a single source; the CLI never spawns a terminal.
